tip.model: Pick from the catalog or type an id. Examples: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6, openai/gpt-4.1, glm-5.3-flash. Can be overridden per session.
tip.agent_max_turns: Example: 30 for short tasks, 60–90 Hermes defaults, 150+ only for very long autonomous work (costs more tokens).
tip.agent_verbose: On: noisy debug logs for the agent loop. Off: normal logging. Turn on only while diagnosing.
tip.context_file_max_chars: Example: 50000 keeps AGENTS.md shorter in context. Unset uses a dynamic limit (~20k–500k) from the model window.
tip.agent_reasoning_effort: Examples: low / medium / high / xhigh. Empty = provider default. Not all models honor every level.
tip.code_execution_mode: project = workspace access (default). strict = tighter isolation. Prefer strict on untrusted tasks.
tip.compression_tail_mode: lean = smaller tail + stronger summary (default). legacy = larger verbatim tail.
tip.updates_pre_update_backup: quick = state snapshot only (pairing, cron, config, auth; skips files >1GiB). full = quick + zip of HERMES_HOME. off = no pre-update backup. Prefer quick or full on machines you care about.
tip.updates_parked_branch_strategy: Default: if the checkout is clean and the parked branch is fully merged, switch back to main. Set update_in_place to keep working on a custom branch and merge origin/main into it. Dirty trees are never force-switched.
tip.approvals_unattended_mode: Controls headless/cron approvals. Prefer deny/manual-like policies on shared hosts; never use permissive unattended mode on production without a sandbox.
tip.agent_run_budget_seconds: Example: 3600 caps a run at one hour of wall time when enforced by the runtime path that reads this key.
